source.reductions: Minimal authored reductions of the pinned source topology. Keep parent patches, source references and dependency ownership. Workloads are local ConfigMaps and authored negative variants.

cases.name: sops-unreadable-active-substitution
cases.description: Preserve TestE2E_SOPSUnreadableActiveSubstitution and its ordered edits.

cases.name: sops-output-scope
cases.description: Final membership follows scope, transformed identity, and command view. Duplicate output identities retain existing producer conflict and key union warnings.

cases.name: sops-output-orphan
cases.description: Static orphan output retains its warning in full and changed-only views. Filters remove only presentation evidence.

cases.name: sops-output-mixed
cases.description: Required mixed data renders without permission. Readable siblings remain usable. Supplied empty data leaves unavailable-key details.

cases.name: sops-output-diff
cases.description: Native changed pairs expose both side warnings. Reversed, normalized, and image-only views retain their own membership.

cases.name: sops-output-shallow
cases.description: A shallow head retains transformed output membership in full and changed-only builds.

cases.name: sops-output-absent-side
cases.description: Additions and removals retain warnings only on their present comparison side.

cases.name: sops-output-partial-failure
cases.description: A failed producer retains strict errors and suppression evidence. Healthy output keeps only its represented encrypted identities.

cases.name: sops-output-internal-namespace
cases.description: ResourceSet internal namespaces identify included raw children without altering output. Distinct producer namespaces and comparison sides remain separate.

cases.name: sops-output-explicit-namespace
cases.description: An explicit child namespace takes precedence over the ResourceSet internal namespace.
